method: Mutants and probes run in a temporary detached Git worktree of the committed sources, supplied with copies of the local-only allowlisted inputs; production files in the working tree are never modified. Every mutated source, probed input and consumer output is restored and verified by SHA-256 (and git diff for sources). Classification fails closed: a survivor needs a clean, complete run; an unexpected exception, a changed output on rejection or an unverified restoration fails the run.
